headline: Bridge Work Snarls Evening Commute
text:
Bridge Work Snarls Evening Commute

Analysts described the decision as a compromise that leaves almost everyone partly satisfied and partly frustrated. Ticket sales have been strong, and organizers say they expect a larger crowd than last year. Officials emphasized that no final decision has been made and that additional hearings will be scheduled. The announcement follows months of quiet negotiations between the agency and neighborhood groups. The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning. The report recommends three changes: shorter meetings, clearer agendas and more time for public comment. A spokesperson for the department declined to comment on the specifics, saying only that a full report would be released soon. Teachers and parents have raised concerns about class sizes, and the district says it is reviewing staffing levels.
